candidates.angle: Kshetra is a field of changes

angle_hi: क्षेत्र में इच्छा और द्वेष आते हैं

en.intro: Krishna has been listing the parts of the body and the mind. But what exactly counts as the field itself, and what does it include?
en.notice: Krishna lists desire and aversion right alongside pleasure and pain, showing the field is the body and the impulses that drive it.
en.meaning: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the body, consciousness, and steadiness: this field, together with its changes, is briefly described.

hi.intro: कृष्ण जी शरीर और मन के हिस्सों को बता रहे हैं। लेकिन यह क्षेत्र क्या है और इसमें क्या-क्या आता है?
hi.meaning: इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख, दुःख, संघात, चेतना और धृति, इन विकारों सहित यह क्षेत्र संक्षेप में कहा गया है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण जी इच्छा और द्वेष को सुख और दुःख के साथ रखते हैं, जिससे यह स्पष्ट होता है कि यह क्षेत्र शरीर, भावनाओं और चेतना का समूह है।
hi.next: फिर वे उस ज्ञानी के गुणों के बारे में बताते हैं जो इस क्षेत्र के बाहर है।

en.intro: Krishna has been listing the parts of the body and the mind. But what exactly counts as the field itself, and what does it include?
en.body: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the body, consciousness, and steadiness: this field, together with its changes, is briefly described. Krishna lists desire and aversion right alongside pleasure and pain, showing the field is the body and the impulses that drive it. Next, Krishna continues.

issues: en.notice: banned phrase "not just the body but"

contrast_template: "जिससे यह स्पष्ट होता है कि यह क्षेत्र केवल शरीर नहीं, बल्कि उन भावनाओं का भी है जो उसे चलाती हैं" (The Hindi notice uses the contrastive structure 'न...बल्कि' (not X, but Y) to imply that the field is exclusively the body and the emotions driving it, which contradicts the source verse stating that the field includes the body, feelings, and steadiness along with its changes. The verse does not limit the field to only the body and emotions.)
